# Tool catalog

Every tool below is documented with its prerequisites and usage. Nothing is preinstalled except the small baseline set; everything else is installed on demand from inside the app.

_46 tools in 11 categories._

## Contents

- **Information Gathering**
  - [DNS Lookup (dig)](tools/dns.md) - Resolves a name and prints the DNS records a resolver returns.
  - [WHOIS Lookup](tools/whois.md) - Looks up the public registration record for a domain or IP address.
  - [Nmap](tools/nmap.md) - Discovers hosts and services by probing ports on a network you are authorised to scan.
  - [Masscan](tools/masscan.md) - An extremely fast port scanner for wide address ranges you are authorised to test.
  - [WhatWeb](tools/whatweb.md) - Fingerprints the technologies behind a website (CMS, frameworks, servers).
  - [DNSRecon](tools/dnsrecon.md) - Enumerates DNS records, subdomains and zone-transfer weaknesses.
  - [theHarvester](tools/theharvester.md) - Collects emails, subdomains and names from public sources (OSINT).
- **Vulnerability Analysis**
  - [Nikto](tools/nikto.md) - Scans a web server for outdated software, risky files and misconfigurations.
  - [Nuclei](tools/nuclei.md) - Runs a large community template library to detect known vulnerabilities and exposures.
  - [Lynis](tools/lynis.md) - Audits the security posture of a Linux host (including the runtime itself).
  - [SearchSploit](tools/searchsploit.md) - Searches the local Exploit-DB archive for published exploits and proofs-of-concept.
- **Web Applications**
  - [SQLMap](tools/sqlmap.md) - Tests whether a web parameter is vulnerable to SQL injection, and can prove it.
  - [Gobuster](tools/gobuster.md) - Brute-forces hidden directories and files on a web server using a wordlist.
  - [ffuf](tools/ffuf.md) - A fast web fuzzer for directories, parameters and virtual hosts.
  - [WPScan](tools/wpscan.md) - Scans a WordPress site for vulnerable plugins, themes and users.
  - [Commix](tools/commix.md) - Tests web parameters for OS command-injection flaws.
  - [Wapiti](tools/wapiti.md) - Black-box web scanner that audits pages for common vulnerabilities.
- **Password Attacks**
  - [Hydra](tools/hydra.md) - Tests whether a login service accepts weak credentials you supply.
  - [John the Ripper](tools/john.md) - Recovers passwords from hashes you already hold, using a wordlist or rules.
  - [Hashcat](tools/hashcat.md) - Fast hash cracking with masks or wordlists; runs at a low workload by default.
  - [Medusa](tools/medusa.md) - Parallel, speedy login brute-forcer for many protocols.
  - [Crunch](tools/crunch.md) - Generates custom wordlists from character sets and patterns.
  - [CeWL](tools/cewl.md) - Builds a targeted wordlist by crawling a website's words.
- **Wireless Attacks**
  - [Aircrack-ng](tools/aircrack-ng.md) - Audits Wi-Fi security using captured handshakes and packet files.
  - [Bettercap](tools/bettercap.md) - A modular framework for network, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth reconnaissance and attacks.
  - [Wifite](tools/wifite.md) - Automates the common Wi-Fi audit workflow around aircrack-ng and friends.
  - [hcxtools](tools/hcxtools.md) - Converts and cleans Wi-Fi capture files into hashcat-ready formats.
- **Exploitation Tools**
  - [Metasploit Framework](tools/metasploit.md) - The standard exploitation framework: search, scan with auxiliary modules, and use exploits.
  - [msfvenom](tools/msfvenom.md) - Generates payloads and shellcode in many formats.
- **Sniffing & Spoofing**
  - [tcpdump](tools/tcpdump.md) - Captures packet headers on an interface, or reads an existing capture.
  - [Packet Analysis (tshark)](tools/tshark.md) - Reads a capture file and summarises conversations, talkers and protocol mix.
  - [Responder](tools/responder.md) - Answers broadcast name-resolution requests to reveal credentials on a Windows network.
- **Post Exploitation**
  - [Netcat](tools/netcat.md) - The TCP/IP Swiss-army knife: banners, port checks, simple transfers.
  - [Socat](tools/socat.md) - Establishes bidirectional streams between many kinds of endpoints.
  - [Weevely](tools/weevely.md) - Generates and operates a small PHP webshell for authorised web tests.
- **Forensics**
  - [Foremost](tools/foremost.md) - Carves files out of a disk image or binary by their headers and footers.
  - [Binwalk](tools/binwalk.md) - Finds and extracts embedded files and filesystems inside firmware or binaries.
  - [PhotoRec](tools/photorec.md) - Recovers deleted files of many types from disks, images and memory cards.
  - [ExifTool](tools/exiftool.md) - Reads and writes metadata in images, documents and media.
  - [Steghide](tools/steghide.md) - Hides or extracts data inside image and audio files.
  - [Volatility 3](tools/volatility3.md) - Analyses memory dumps to list processes, connections and injected code.
  - [The Sleuth Kit](tools/sleuthkit.md) - Command-line tools to examine disk images at the filesystem level.
- **Reverse Engineering**
  - [Radare2](tools/radare2.md) - A framework for disassembling, debugging and analysing binaries.
  - [GDB](tools/gdb.md) - The GNU debugger, for stepping through and inspecting running programs.
  - [strace](tools/strace.md) - Traces the system calls a program makes.
- **Reporting**
  - [Report Builder](tools/report.md) - Turns your findings and audit trail into an HTML, JSON or CSV report.
